accept.specs:
spec fn ref_pre(a: &[i64]) -> bool { forall|i: usize, j: usize| i < j && j < a.len() ==> #[trigger] a[i] <= #[trigger] a[j] }
spec fn ref_post(a: &[i64], t: i64, r: usize) -> bool { r <= a.len() && (r < a.len() ==> a[r] == t) && (r == a.len() ==> (forall|k: usize| k < a.len() ==> #[trigger] a[k] != t)) }
